description: Your year in review, written by the visual. Bind a date and a measure, optionally up to two category fields, and SmartVisuals Year in Review writes the year-end recap for you, so nobody has to: bold story cards in plain language, paged like stories on a wall screen and laid out as a static grid for PDF and PowerPoint. The free tier includes every built-in card. Free: the whole story Cards the visual writes itself: headline total, peak month, week and day, top lists for two fields, biggest mover within the year, longest streak (working days aware), weekday rhythm, records, milestones and the halfway date, a personality for the year and a summary. Contextual labels: every card carries a written line from the data that names the measure and the period. Honest copy for every case: ties are named, a lead too small to show is called a close race, negative values never get shares, a year to date says so, monthly tables never get a daily peak, percentages are averaged. Trend indicators and sparklines: up and down arrow badges on the biggest-mover card, month-by-month bars on the total card, weekday or month bars on the rhythm card. Localized: the format pane in 20 languages; the written story in English, Czech and German with real grammar, following the report, else English. Periods: the latest year, a chosen or fiscal year, the last 12 months or the whole date range. Advanced…
